summary: A recent explosion on a railway track in Quetta, Pakistan has killed at least 10 people and injured more than 50 others. The blast derailed a cargo train and was followed by heavy gunfire. The attack comes amidst ongoing unrest in Balochistan, linked to Baloch separatist groups. The situation is evolving, with potential links to previous violent incidents in the region.
